scope: Refresh the installed app's icon and metadata; prevent preserved installation timestamps from leaving a stale placeholder.

findings.staleSearchCache: Suspected from the user's search screenshot; the icon asset itself was valid.

repair: Refreshed only the installed bundle, metadata and icon timestamps
Forced registration of the installed bundle with Launch Services
Requested Spotlight import of the installed bundle
Added these refresh steps to the installer
limitations: Finder's Get Info icon and preview were visually verified. Spotlight search could not be opened through the UI automation service; its launch request failed. Reopen any existing search panel to reload its contents.
Installer refresh steps were applied directly to the installed bundle. The complete installer was not rerun while Habit Gate was running.
No Swift or browser source changed; their test suites were not rerun.
